pairs.subject: broadcast-chain-showcase-capture
pairs.evidence: docs/guide/recording.md:5 The repo records only OBS's own program output of the stage (one picture, one clock) and has no showcase film that captures a tool window, broadcast output and platform player together, and a search of packages/stage-kit for showcase, player.twitch, end marker, latency, probe and getDisplayMedia found nothing, so this context's overlay components are the product being aired, not a chain-capture driver.

techniques.evidence: packages/stage-kit/src/ui/index.ts:2 These are the product's own broadcast overlays, styled as the OBS canvas skin. There is no showcase director here that picks which overlay a shot is about.
docs/guide/recording.md:5 No platform player is ever recorded, so there is no platform delay to measure.
docs/guide/recording.md:3 The only recording is OBS rendering its own browser source. Nothing is captured from the desktop, so there are no windows to own.
docs/guide/recording.md:5 No take runs through the platform chain, so the precondition does not hold.
docs/guide/recording.md:5 There is a single recording on one clock, which is the technique's own 'when not to use it' case.
